name: Pegasus
author: Tyler Kamstra
sourceDistinctions: The player traits sit on printed p. 168. P. 169 contains the play advice and design discussion. Use the 40-ft. walk and 50-ft. flight from the traits. Hooves are Strength-based melee weapon attacks for 2014 Rage and Reckless Attack.

name: Piercer
author: Tyler Kamstra
sourceDistinctions: Drop specifies a melee weapon attack without giving proficiency. The worked NPC treats Drop as an innate, proficient Strength attack. Its landing treatment follows the printed hit and miss branches, with normal fall prone behavior if the miss deals falling damage.

name: Pseudodragon
author: Tyler Kamstra
sourceDistinctions: Explicit finesse clause allows 2014 Sneak Attack. The player sting has no poison effect. Apply v2 pp. 7–8 for the shared Tiny rules.

name: Purple Worm
author: Tyler Kamstra
page: p. 172 in v2, Purple Worm Traits
sourceDistinctions: The Monstrosity line is printed in a different column below the trait heading in the text extraction. The NPC treats blindsight as sight within range for Danger Sense. Add attack and Rage damage modifiers once, to the piercing component of Stinger.

name: Remorhaz
author: Tyler Kamstra
sourceDistinctions: The player traits specify both damage types and no ability-score increase. Apply the ability modifier once to the bite’s piercing damage. The p. 7 monk rule makes the bonus Martial Arts strike ordinary bludgeoning.
